items.prompt:
On these questions, evidence must directly support the:
A) claim in the question
B) longest answer
C) first word

Evidence that is about the topic but not the specific claim is:
A) off-point
B) the best support
C) always correct

Some SAT evidence questions ask which finding:
A) weakens a claim
B) is the longest
C) rhymes

Claim: 'The new teaching method improved student writing.' Which BEST supports it?
A) students said the class was fun
B) essay scores rose 18% after the method
C) the teacher had ten years' experience
items.answer: B) essay scores rose 18% after the method

steps: Directly measures writing. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) essay scores rose 18% after the method

items.prompt:
Claim: 'The bridge is unsafe.' Which finding WEAKENS it?
A) a recent inspection found no defects
B) the bridge is old
C) the bridge is long
items.answer: A) a recent inspection found no defects

solution.answer: A) a recent inspection found no defects

items.prompt:
Why is 'students said the class was fun' NOT the best support for 'the method improved writing'?
A) enjoyment does not directly measure improved writing
B) it is false
C) it is too short
items.answer: A) enjoyment does not directly measure improved writing

solution.answer: A) enjoyment does not directly measure improved writing

items.prompt:
Claim: 'Planting trees along streets lowers summer temperatures.' Which BEST supports it?
A) tree-lined blocks measured 4°F cooler than bare blocks in summer
B) residents like trees
C) trees take years to grow
items.answer: A) tree-lined blocks measured 4°F cooler than bare blocks in summer

steps: Direct temperature comparison. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) tree-lined blocks measured 4°F cooler than bare blocks in summer

items.prompt:
Claim: 'The medicine works no better than a placebo.' Which finding WEAKENS this claim?
A) patients on the medicine recovered far faster than those on the placebo
B) the medicine is expensive
C) the pills look alike
items.answer: A) patients on the medicine recovered far faster than those on the placebo

solution.answer: A) patients on the medicine recovered far faster than those on the placebo
